gap.behavioural_impact: In a period format Armored Glass should neither be activatable off, nor shut down, a Union monster equipped to a monster or an equipping Trap - only Equip Spells - whereas the shipped card negates every Equip Card on the field.

upstream_implementations is empty. Chain starts at v2 (PSV-EN019 as reprinted in Master Collection Volume 1, 2004-12-01), the newest dated text before the GOAT snapshot; pre-baseline v0 (PSV-019, 2002-10-20) and v1 (PSV-E019) differ only by the Magic->Spell terminology rename and by v2 adding the redundant 'only' to the activation clause, all behaviourally identical. The 'Equip Spell Card' -> 'Equip Card' rewrite lands in v3, which has number null, sets [] and no dating_set, so there is no set-release evidence to attach and the change is recorded with effective {}: whether the 2005-04-01 GOAT and 2010-04-24 Edison snapshots sit before or after it is genuinely unknown, and the applier's fail-safe (BLOCKED inside an unresolved interval) is the honest outcome. Trailing v3 -> v4 (PSV-EN019 in Pharaoh's Servant 25th Anniversary Edition, 2023-04-20) merely drops 'only' and is the text pinned in cards.cdb; it is not recorded as a change. No entry for this card in edison-functional-errata.md.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, Armored Glass). No period ruling in the corpus settles a claimed difference, so the functional call stands unchanged (`unresolved` at both snapshots); the search is recorded in the check. Verdicts: [event] d1 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu; d2 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu.

event.historical_text: You can only activate this card when a monster is equipped with an Equip Spell Card. Negate the effects of all Equip Spell Cards on the field during the turn this card is activated.
event.modern_text: You can only activate this card when a monster is equipped with an Equip Card. Negate the effects of all Equip Cards on the field during the turn this card is activated.
event.summary: Functional scope change with no datable printing: 'Equip Spell Card' becomes 'Equip Card' in both halves of the effect, so both the activation condition (a monster equipped with an Equip Card) and the negation (the effects of all Equip Cards on the field) widen from Equip Spells alone to every card treated as an Equip Card - Union monsters equipped to a monster and Trap Cards that equip included. The lineage version that introduces the wording carries no card number and no set, so the date of the change cannot be established from the packet.

rulings_check.difference: Activation condition: era 'a monster is equipped with an Equip Spell Card'; later 'an Equip Card', which also counts a Union monster equipped to a monster or a Trap Card that equips. Negation: era negates 'all Equip Spell Cards on the field'; later 'all Equip Cards', which also shuts off equipped Union monsters and equipping Traps.
